# Welcome to Box Office Numbers

This website explores a dataset of 104 well-known films released between 1980 and 2025. The dataset includes production budgets, worldwide box-office revenues, film runtimes, IMDb ratings, and franchise information.

Through three analysis pages, we examine the relationship between production budgets and revenues, investigate how film runtime relates to IMDb ratings, and explore box-office performance across James Bond films.
